project_overview: This project appears to be a Vue.js application likely related to an educational institution, judging by the file names (ExamFormSubmission, HallTicketPage, ResultPage). It leverages Vue components for various functionalities including user interface elements, data handling, and potentially routing based on the connection data. The dependency graph suggests a core application service component (`ApplicationServices.vue`) acts as a central hub, connecting to other components and likely handling business logic.

layers.description: Responsible for rendering the user interface and handling user interactions.

macro_trends.title: Potential Centralized Fragility - ApplicationServices.vue
macro_trends.description: The `ApplicationServices.vue` component is a key entry point and is heavily relied upon by several other components. This concentration of functionality suggests a potential bottleneck and increased risk if this component is modified or requires significant updates. Careful consideration should be given to refactoring this file into smaller, more manageable services.

macro_trends.title: UI Component Dependency Risks
macro_trends.description: Numerous components are directly routed to `ApplicationServices.vue`, creating a potential dependency chain. Changes to the presentation layer could have cascading effects on the core application logic. A more modular approach to routing and component design would mitigate this risk.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: The `ExamFormSubmission.vue` component and associated routing likely manage the flow of data for exam submissions, connecting to `ApplicationServices.vue` for data processing and potentially updating the `ResultPage.vue` component when the submission is complete.

key_workflows.name: User Navigation & Data Retrieval
key_workflows.description: The extensive routing connections suggest a design where users navigate through various components (e.g., `iLikeCourses`, `iLikeDashboard`) and retrieve data through `ApplicationServices.vue`. This creates a critical path that requires careful performance optimization and design for scalability.
